definition: The harmonic mean of precision and recall, used as a single summary metric for classification performance.
details: F1 score balances the trade-off between precision and recall and is especially useful for imbalanced datasets where accuracy alone can be misleading.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. Think of it this way: The harmonic mean of precision and recall, used as a single summary metric for classification performance. And here is the clever part: F1 score balances the trade-off between precision and recall and is especially useful for imbalanced datasets where accuracy alone can be misleading. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. And that, done honestly, is F1 Score.
